name.value: Festina Lente Estate Winery and Meadery

description.value: Festina Lente is a 5-acre family-run hobby farm in Langley's wine country, specializing in award-winning mead and honey wines crafted by beekeepers-turned-winemakers Bill and Teresa. The farm hosts a covered, heated patio with walk-in tastings, free live music events, and a weekend food truck serving flatbreads, gourmet hot dogs, charcuterie boards, and high tea boxes. Touring cyclists with dogs are explicitly welcomed, and the winery's Renaissance Faire and seasonal events make it a distinctive rural stop on any Langley route.
